EVAL-PROVIDER-QUALITY-S1.title: Define Provider Quality Snapshot Schema and Contract
EVAL-PROVIDER-QUALITY-S1.description: Define a structured schema for provider quality snapshot including credential, specialty, license state, status, enumeration date, and address fields sourced from NPI data, with explicit field typing, null-handling rules, and alignment to API response contract for downstream consumers.

EVAL-PROVIDER-QUALITY-S2.title: Implement Provider Quality Mapping Logic from NPI Data
EVAL-PROVIDER-QUALITY-S2.description: Extract and normalize NPI registry fields from provider_detail_service into the defined snapshot schema, including deterministic credential parsing, specialty normalization, license state mapping, and traceable handling of missing or inconsistent values.

EVAL-PROVIDER-QUALITY-S3.title: Expose Provider Quality Snapshot via EvaluateCare Facade
EVAL-PROVIDER-QUALITY-S3.description: Extend evaluate_care_facade to include provider quality snapshot in provider detail responses, enforcing schema contract and ensuring compatibility with tool_router dispatch and existing response structures.

EVAL-PROVIDER-QUALITY-S4.title: Render Provider Quality Snapshot in Chat UI
EVAL-PROVIDER-QUALITY-S4.description: Display provider quality snapshot fields in the frontend chat interface using structured label/value rendering, ensuring readability, consistent formatting, and graceful handling of missing or partial data.

EVAL-PROVIDER-QUALITY-S5.title: Unit and Integration Tests for Provider Quality Snapshot
EVAL-PROVIDER-QUALITY-S5.description: Implement unit tests for schema validation and mapping logic, and integration tests validating end-to-end flow from NPI provider_detail_service through evaluate_care_facade to API response and frontend rendering contract.
